title: Mill Race
shortDescription: Fast water beside a wheel that no longer turns.
longDescription:
The race runs fast and brown beside a mill wheel furred with moss. The wheel does not turn. Something long holds the current if it has not been sent on.
North is the osier holt. West is the skiff-line. South is the black mooring.

fixtures.name: Still Wheel
fixtures.lookDescription: A mill wheel that does not turn. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: The wheel is sound. The axle is packed with reed on purpose, so the race stays a hiding place. Pulling the reed out is a job for a dry day and a grown otter with a wrench. Today, look, and leave the axle.
